calibration.method: sigmoid (Platt) fitted on the validation split

blank Lead Source.reason: In this dataset a blank source marks leads added by hand (81% convert), while in the CRM it only means the field was left empty; keeping them would make 'source not provided' raise the score.

excluded_leakage.Tags: Sales-rep status recorded after contact ('Will revert after reading the email' converts 97%, 'Ringing' 3%).
excluded_leakage.Lead Quality: Sales-rep judgement recorded after contact ('High in Relevance' converts 95%, 'Worst' 2%).
excluded_leakage.Lead Profile: Assigned by the sales team after qualification ('Potential Lead' converts 79%).
excluded_leakage.Last Activity: Latest touch-point at extraction time, largely sales actions (SMS sent, phone call); unknown when a lead is created.
excluded_leakage.Last Notable Activity: Same as Last Activity; snapshot at extraction time.
excluded_leakage.Asymmetrique Activity Index: Scores assigned by the business after profiling; 46% missing.
excluded_leakage.Asymmetrique Profile Index: Scores assigned by the business after profiling; 46% missing.
excluded_leakage.Asymmetrique Activity Score: Scores assigned by the business after profiling; 46% missing.
excluded_leakage.Asymmetrique Profile Score: Scores assigned by the business after profiling; 46% missing.

excluded_other.Do Not Email: Consent signal; scoring is kept consent-agnostic (the consent layer enforces it).
excluded_other.Country: 27% missing, 96% India among known values; location is also a fairness risk.
excluded_other.City: 40% missing or unselected; location is also a fairness risk.
excluded_other.Specialization: No added predictive value in cross-validation (AUC +0.001).
excluded_other.A free copy of Mastering The Interview: Weak signal (40% vs 36% conversion); not a CRM form field.

selection_rule: highest 5-fold CV ROC-AUC; simplest model within 0.005 preferred
serving_rules: Missing numeric inputs are imputed with the training median and are not cited in top_factors.
A missing lead origin or source is filled with the most common training value (neutral) and is not cited in top_factors; a missing occupation is a learned category ('not provided').
Categories never seen in training (e.g. source 'Event') are encoded as an infrequent category, never an error.
If occupation is missing but the job title maps to a seniority level, occupation is taken as 'Working Professional' (shown as '(from job title)').
Consent is not a model input; the consent layer decides what may be done with a lead.
